subject: prd/local-work-tracker
statement: When asked for any read or query, the tracker shall additionally emit schema-versioned, machine-readable structured output; and every mutation shall be scriptable and return the affected identifier(s).
rationale: scripts and the engine consume structured data, never scraped prose (AP-6); `gh --json` parity the factory depends on (harbormaster sweep §2)
fit_criterion: every read/query verb's JSON parses against its golden schema; mutations return ids parseable by a script
